title: Audio Library
search: Search title, artist, album or genre
confirmDeleteOne: “{{title}}” and its files will be removed from the server. This action cannot be undone.
confirmDeleteBody: You are about to delete {{count}} audio file(s). This action cannot be undone.
processingHint_one: {{count}} upload is being processed. This list updates automatically.
processingHint_other: {{count}} uploads are being processed. This list updates automatically.
emptyBody: Upload your first tracks to start building the station's library.
noResultsBody: Nothing matches “{{query}}”. Try a different search.

upload.title: Upload audio
upload.subtitle: Add tracks to this studio's library. They are converted for broadcast automatically.
upload.dropTitle: Drag and drop audio files here, or click to browse
upload.dropHint: You can select several files at once (up to {{batch}} per batch works best)

warnings.skipped_one: {{count}} file was skipped because it is not an audio file.
warnings.skipped_other: {{count}} files were skipped because they are not audio files.
warnings.largeBatch: {{count}} files are in the list. Batches of {{batch}} or fewer are easier to follow and recover if the connection drops.
warnings.largeFiles_one: {{count}} file is larger than {{size}}. It will work but take longer. Consider exporting it as MP3 or FLAC instead of WAV.
warnings.largeFiles_other: {{count}} files are larger than {{size}}. They will work but take longer. Consider exporting them as MP3 or FLAC instead of WAV.
warnings.alreadyListed_one: {{count}} file is already in the list and was not added again.
warnings.alreadyListed_other: {{count}} files are already in the list and were not added again.

errors.session: Could not start the upload. Please try again.
errors.finalize: The file was sent but could not be queued for processing.

formats.title: Formats
formats.body: MP3, WAV, FLAC, M4A or OGG; best at 192 kbps+ or lossless. Converted to {{kbps}} kbps MP3.

batch.title: Batch
batch.body: Up to {{batch}} files, ideally under {{size}} each; {{concurrency}} upload at once.

tags.title: Tags
tags.body: Title, artist and album are read from file tags; volume is levelled automatically. Files already in the library are skipped.

connection.title: Stay here
connection.body: Keep this window open until all are Done; Retry any that fail. Tracks are Ready a few minutes later.

possibleDuplicateOf: Same title, artist and length as “{{title}}” by {{artist}}. Delete one if they are the same recording.
